Theorem
[Regularity of Aleksandrov spaces] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0433 1. appG:G.60\group Aleksandrov structure There is a full-Hausdorff-measure subset $X_0$ whose complement contains the singular set, and the metric on $X_0$ is induced by a $C^{1/2}$ Riemannian metric extending continuously over $X-S_X$. The space is approximately twice differentiable almost everywhere. A geodesically complete Aleksandrov space is isometric to a $C^{1,\alpha }$ Riemannian metric on a smooth manifold.
